path_title: Path 5: Java 11 to Java 17 (LTS to LTS)

sources.summary: Highlights significant removed APIs, tools, and components the agent must flag during migration to Java 17.
Mandates the removal of --illegal-access flags and provides rules for handling InaccessibleObjectException through explicitly declared --add-opens manifests.
Outlines the AST mapping rules for converting fall-through switch statements into exhaustive poly expressions utilizing yield and -> syntax.
Defines constraints for immutable data carriers, detailing accessor generation and restrictions on inheritance and state mutability.
Details operational behavior of canonical versus custom constructors and the implementation of java.lang.Record for serialization proxy generation.
